correctness.rationale: The proof defines all sequences, window domains and exact normalization; squares become linear combinations of C_(2j) and C_(2j-1), telescoping gives initial sums, and strong divisibility computes the entire infinite difference GCD. Odd prime comparisons and exact 2-/3-adic valuations yield the simultaneous formulas. Executed standalone exact-integer code verified 37,440 direct window cases plus recurrence identities; these experiments corroborate but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Question 30 of the primary 2023 paper explicitly requests square-window GCD formulas for the balancing, Lucas-balancing and Lucas-cobalancing families and records two unproved numerical relations. The theorem determines all three infinite sliding-square GCD functions as explicit finite gcd operations, proves both relations for all lengths, and isolates the parity and ternary arithmetic mechanisms. The remaining gcd(k,B_k) is a natural but unevaluated invariant, noted as a limitation.
